Use the reviewed inventory to implement one component in the complete SharedIkasan4 starter pack.
Read schemas, GENERATION_RULES.md and the maintained direct-construction examples. Use only known
metadata fields. Construct the actual shared class using a supported factory/constructor/template;
do not assume a standard Ikasan builder instantiates a subclass. Keep business implementation in
its existing internal library, and add the correct generated-application Maven dependency separately
from the authoring test dependency. Use synthetic fixtures. Mark unsupported wiring/types explicitly.
Run offline verification with --build-only after intentional edits. Do not weaken validation/tests.
